messages:
sophie (product): Quick sync: final GA acceptance checklist for Real-time Optimize — need owners on SLA, docs, support flow, monitoring, pricing by EOD Wed. TL;DR: numeric SLOs, runbook, billing plan, and customer comms.
ajay (eng): Quick Q — can we do a single SLA? hosted perf is variable. I think tiered (hosted/dedicated/private) is safer.
frank (sre): +1 to tiered. Draft SLA proposal below. I'll own incident runbook and oncall routing.
frank (sre): ```
SLA proposal:
- Hosted: 99.5% availability, p99 latency < 300ms
- Dedicated: 99.9% availability, p99 latency < 200ms
- Private: 99.99% availability (customer infra dependent)
```
ajay (eng): We should call out graceful degradation: automatic fallback to smaller model variant and circuit-breaker at token cost threshold. I'll add to runtime README and perf playbook.
katy (docs): I'll draft the Quickstart, FAQ, and a short "What to expect at GA" doc. Need canonical wording for SLA and a billing table. Assign docs owner: @katy.
sophie (product): Owners: ajay -> hosted perf doc + fallback behavior, frank -> incident playbook + monitoring alerting, katy -> docs + release notes, sophie -> pricing tiers & customer comms.
sophie (product): Beta customers (Boxl, Sprout) have asked for 99.9 — we'll need a commercial exception conversation for them. @frank can you estimate operational risk?
frank (sre): For dedicated we can support 99.9; hosted for these customers would need reserved pools or burst guarantees. Risk: capacity and multi-tenant noisy neighbors. Estimate: +2 engineers for 2 months for hardened autoscaling and capacity planning.
ajay (eng): I'll prepare a simple runbook snippet for fallback behavior and a perf checklist for canary: synthetic clients with 95th/99th latency dashboards.
katy (docs): Pricing draft please — even placeholder numbers help the docs table.
sophie (product): Draft pricing (very rough):
```
Pricing (draft):
- Free: 10k tokens/mo
- Starter: $0.0008 per token up to 1M tokens
- Pro (reserved): $X/mo for baseline capacity + $0.0005 per additional token
- Enterprise: custom SLA/pricing
```
ajay (eng): Sounds fine as a starting point. We'll need to map Starter/Pro to tiers that enforce autoscale/priority routing.
frank (sre): Monitoring items: synthetic transactions every 60s, p99 latency alert (> target + 20%), error rate >5% alert, token-cost anomaly alert. I'll add alerts to the GA checklist.
katy (docs): I'll include the monitoring section and a short "How we measure SLA" explainer. Need exact metric names from infra — @ajay can you confirm metric keys?
ajay (eng): metric names: runtime.p99_latency_ms, runtime.availability_pct, runtime.error_rate_pct, billing.tokens_consumed. I'll add them to the perf doc.
sophie (product): OK — actionable owners and next steps:
- ajay: perf doc + metrics (due Tue EOD)
- frank: incident runbook + alerts + oncall routing (due Tue EOD)
- katy: Quickstart + FAQ + SLA wording + release notes (draft Tue)
- sophie: pricing tiers + beta comms (draft Mon)
ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-4321: "GA readiness — Real-time Optimize SLA/docs/pricing" and assigned to @sophie, @ajay, @frank, @katy. Link: https://go/redwood/PROD-4321
sophie (product): thanks all. If anyone hits blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
